semantics: Documentation graphs, not executable n8n workflows. Edges are process/data-flow compositions supported by references; planned edges are proposals.
title: Returns & exchanges
subtitle: Implemented request and approval; replacement fulfillment is a proposed extension

nodes.label: Choose return / exchange
nodes.description: Return and exchange forms collect reason, pickup details, items and optional replacement SKU.

nodes.label: POST return request
nodes.description: Strict input schema and customerOrder ownership check.

nodes.label: Delivered and within window?
nodes.description: Paid courier-confirmed delivery, no active refund and unexpired deadline are required. Exchange validates replacement availability without reserving it.

nodes.label: Create care review ticket
nodes.description: Idempotent tickets and support conversation capture the requested order action.

nodes.label: tickets + returns decision
nodes.description: Admin approves or rejects the request; returns stores inspection decision and links ticketId/orderRawId.

nodes.label: Request status visible
nodes.description: Customer can follow the support request; approval does not disburse funds.

nodes.label: Request failed
nodes.description: Validation, access, conflict or service errors are returned to the caller. Status and error shape depend on the specific route.

nodes.label: Show error / retry
nodes.description: Failure end state. Caller receives the actual error; a retry may be offered by the UI.

nodes.label: Arrange replacement fulfillment
nodes.description: Proposed extension: reserve replacement stock, arrange reverse pickup and issue a replacement order after inspection. No implementation mapping is claimed.

notes: Source implementation is documented; deployed configuration and provider connectivity are not verified.
No automatic replacement order creation, replacement stock reservation or reverse pickup execution was found in the reviewed return request and approval paths. Those steps are Planned.
